about_the_game:
This is a 3D action game. Enemies are powerful, the difficulty is high, and players must advance step by step to find their own rhythm under constant pressure.

Combat System / Features
The core of combat revolves around breaking Super Armor. Perfect parries and dodges build up energy, which can unleash powerful armor-breaking strikes. Players may also use high-risk moves, but if misused, the cost will be heavy.

Unique Narrative
This is not merely an outer battle, but a reflection of the struggles within. In childhood, our dreams burned bright and pure — yet they were fragile. Growing up means compromise, and with each compromise, that light dims a little more. Ordinary as we are, we all get dragged into the battlefield of life. But if we can learn to accept ourselves even in the dark, we may find a truer kind of strength.

Developer’s Note
This is not a grand AAA title. It is small in scale. But I hope that within these limits, I can leave something different: a fragmented narrative, an unusual combat system. If it sparks even a fleeting moment of surprise or resonance in you, then that is its purpose. May the power of the Choedon Stone be with you.

name: SIRO

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 6GB or equivalent AMD GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with Windows audio device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 or equivalent AMD GPU
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with Windows audio device
